solution:

Logic: One additional composite triangle formed by combining smaller ones → 1

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/738b4813a5da27d795e7b1e7e10503436b0b611bbd8e09bddcc6de189ef85264.png] 

Thus, 4 (small)+4 (medium)+3 (large)=**11​**​​

Hence, the correct answer is 'Option 2'.
